race_name: L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France

top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before February.
When someone attacks on pancake-flat speed paradise, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.

Road-specific control matters at L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France. Practice on pancake-flat speed paradise: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 63 miles.
63 miles on pancake-flat speed paradise burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France's pancake-flat speed paradise rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France. Train it until it feels boring.
At L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
2-minute all-out efforts on pancake-flat speed paradise. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France's pancake-flat speed paradise actually does to you.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Base fitness for L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for L'Etape Cancun by Tour de France's 63 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, VO2max, and Road Specific to prepare you for 63 miles of pancake-flat speed paradise in Cancun, Quintana Roo, Mexico.
